segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קל
עַל־יְדֵי עֲנָוָה נִצּוֹל מִנִּאוּף וְזוֹכֶה לִשְׁמִירַת הַבְּרִית, אֲבָל עַל־יְדֵי גַּאֲוָה וְגַדְלוּת מִתְגַּבֵּר עָלָיו הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע בְּתַאֲוָה זֹאת:
segments.en: Through breaking immoral thoughts and meriting the rectification of the minds as above — through this one merits to dream through an angel. And then one is called a human being. And in the opposite direction — when the minds are not pure — then the dream comes through a demon — G-d forbid. And then one resembles an animal.
